caption.text: Exon–domain boundary analysis of Homo Sapiens PTPN11. Internal coding-exon boundaries were projected onto amino-acid coordinates of NP_001317366.1 and classified relative to representative InterPro domains using a near-edge threshold of 5 amino acids (protein_1_based_inclusive). Classifications describe positional overlap only and do not by themselves imply a functional effect.
